bible.logline: A seamless, unbroken 40-second continuous 9:16 vertical Steadicam oner tracking two avant-garde models through rainy midnight Soho into the SEPHORA flagship and back to the wet pavement, linked across four +10s Gemini Omni extensions.
bible.storytelling_mode: Mode B: Continuous Scene Extension Chain (Oner)

environment.atmospheric_particles: Fine airborne London rain drizzle, water droplets on patent leather, cosmetic shimmer powder catching light.

Maya's scarlet trench coat remains high-gloss patent leather without texture drift.
Kaelen's charcoal blazer maintains chalk-white stripe accents without color bleeding.

camera_rig.composition: Dynamic vertical framing emphasizing towering model silhouettes, high-fashion angles, and macro beauty details.
camera_rig.route: Rapid tracking shots, snappy whip-pans, and stabilizing push-ins.
camera_rig.action_anchor: Model facial expressions and tactile product interactions.
camera_rig.focus_axis: Shallow f/1.8 depth of field creating vertical oval anamorphic bokeh in wet city lights.

foley_cues: Rapid rhythmic stiletto heel clicks on wet cobblestone
Passing double-decker bus wet tire spray and diesel roar
Pneumatic whoosh of glass sliding doors opening
Metallic magnetic click of luxury lipstick cap disengaging
Crisp paper bag snap and handle tension sound
sonic_blueprint.room_acoustics: Wet, reverberant London street exterior transitioning sharply into hyper-clean, acoustically dampened luxury retail interior.

master_bgm.track_title: Midnight Velvet: UK Garage Pulse (40s Continuous Oner)
master_bgm.genre_style: Syncopated UK Garage / Hyper-Pop Runway Sizzle
instrumentation: Syncopated 2-step drum groove with punchy kick and crisp rimshots
Glittering hyper-pop synth arpeggios and vocal chops
Dramatic snare roll risers and white-noise sweeps

stems.percussion: Syncopated 2-step garage kicks, snappy rimshots, and shaker syncopations
stems.bass: Heavy rolling Reese bassline and sub drone
stems.harmony: Glittering hyper-pop synth arpeggios and atmospheric pads
stems.lead: Processed vocal chops and staccato melodic hooks

master_bgm.dynamic_arc: Seconds 00-10: Intimate street rain ambiance and skipping 2-step groove during Soho approach. Seconds 10-20: Rolling Reese bass drops as models enter the flagship, whispering 'London, wake up'. Seconds 20-30: Soaring hyper-pop synth arpeggios and white-noise riser as bag is lifted. Seconds 30-40: Climactic percussion impact at second 38 snapping into dead silence on bag freeze.
master_bgm.lyria_prompt: High-energy UK Garage fashion runway track, 138 BPM, F Minor. Syncopated skipping 2-step beats, punchy kick drum, driving Moog bassline, glittering hyper-pop synth arpeggios, and edgy vocal chops. Builds rapidly with dramatic snare roll risers into an explosive, sleek high-fashion drop, ending abruptly on a crisp impact hit.

action_beats: Model Maya struts down rain-slicked Soho cobblestones at midnight under glowing neon signage.
A red double-decker bus streaks past with wet tire spray in the background.
Maya reaches the glowing glass facade of the SEPHORA flagship, heels clicking firmly on wet stone.
scenes.kinetic_contact_chain: Stiletto strike -> Ground reaction force -> Arm swing momentum -> Controlled approach -> Hand touches entrance door handle.
scenes.omni_prose_prompt: A 10-second continuous 9:16 vertical tracking shot glides backward at natural 1.0x real-time speed ahead of Model Maya matching <image_1>, who struts down a rain-slicked Soho cobblestone avenue at midnight. Maya wears a high-gloss scarlet-red patent trench coat with metallic stiletto boots, her eyes adorned with vivid holographic emerald eyeshadow. Maya's stride preserves forward kinetic momentum conservation and continuous physical inertia with crisp ground contact. Neon signage from vintage clubs reflects across the wet asphalt with genuine physical reflections as an iconic red London bus streaks past in the background with wet asphalt tire hiss. Maya approaches the glowing glass facade of a SEPHORA flagship, her heels clicking crisply against the stones with unyielding physical gravity. Synchronized diegetic audio features rhythmic stiletto clicks, wet tire hisses, city rain mist, and a skipping 138 BPM UK Garage drum rhythm, ending as Maya extends her hand to push open the store entrance.

council_report.pm_persona_prompt: You are a world-class senior product manager that recently joined this project from a top software company. You will inspect everything about this product and recommend new features and improvements to the product council who will then implement it.

pm_recommendations.title: Industry NLE Timeline & Production Export Suite (EDL, FCPXML, CSV, Call Sheet)
pm_recommendations.problem_statement: Commercial directors and post-production editors reviewing pre-vis storyboards for 'SEPHORA: London Pulse (Continuous 40s Oner)' need direct timeline handoff into DaVinci Resolve, Premiere Pro, and Final Cut Pro without manual re-logging.
pm_recommendations.proposed_solution: Ship omni_director.tools.nle_export (CMX 3600 24fps EDL, FCPXML v1.10, CSV shot list, and Markdown Production Call Sheet) plus the `omni export` CLI subcommand.

pm_recommendations.title: SMPTE Dialogue Pacing Guardrail & Closed Caption Suite (SRT & WebVTT)
pm_recommendations.problem_statement: Over-stuffed spoken dialogue in 8-second clips causes accelerated lip-sync artifacts, and enterprise creative reviews require synchronized closed captions (SRT/VTT) and live animatic CC overlays.
pm_recommendations.proposed_solution: Ship omni_director.tools.dialogue with a 2.5 WPS speech-rate guardrail, SubRip (.srt) and WebVTT (.vtt) compilers, and an interactive #animatic-cc-hud overlay ([C] hotkey) in the Cinema UI.

pm_recommendations.title: Multi-Cam Coverage & Conversational Delta Branching Engine
pm_recommendations.problem_statement: Single-angle scene prompts limit editorial cutting flexibility; directors need A/B/C camera coverage (24mm Master Wide, 50mm Dynamic Hero, 100mm Macro Insert) and Turn 2-4 conversational edit deltas.
pm_recommendations.proposed_solution: Ship omni_director.tools.coverage (generate_scene_coverage & synthesize_conversational_deltas) and interactive .coverage-selector multi-cam tabs inside each scene card in the HTML5 animatic.

pm_recommendations.title: ASC CDL Color Science, Cinematic Look Presets & SVG Filter Grading Engine
pm_recommendations.problem_statement: Commercial directors, DPs, and colorists reviewing storyboards for 'SEPHORA: London Pulse (Continuous 40s Oner)' require industry-standard ASC CDL transfer functions (Slope, Offset, Power, Saturation) and established look presets (Kodak 5219, Fuji Eterna, Bleach Bypass, Teal & Orange) for DaVinci Resolve handoff rather than raw static hex codes.
pm_recommendations.proposed_solution: Implement AscCdlSpec and ColorLookSpec schemas, omni_director.tools.color_grade (Resolve CDL XML export and EDL SOP/SAT comments), and real-time SVG filter grading matrices in the HTML5 animatic.

pm_recommendations.title: Dynamic Speed Ramping, Shutter Angle & Motion Timing Engine
pm_recommendations.problem_statement: High-velocity commercial spots for 'SEPHORA: London Pulse (Continuous 40s Oner)' require dynamic speed ramping (time-warp keyframe curves) and explicit 180° / 90° shutter angle calibration to eliminate temporal smearing or stutter in Gemini Omni video generation.
pm_recommendations.proposed_solution: Implement SpeedRampCurveSpec, shutter timing camera grammar in CraftCameraSpec, omni_director.tools.speed_ramp (FCPXML timeMap export), prompt auditor shutter verification, and animatic velocity curve scrubbing.

pm_recommendations.title: Interactive Diegetic Stem Audio Mixer & Metering Console
pm_recommendations.problem_statement: Omni Director models high-fidelity 4-stem sound design (Dialogue, Foley, Ambience, BGM) for 'SEPHORA: London Pulse (Continuous 40s Oner)', but pitch reviews require interactive channel balance, solo/mute auditioning, and broadcast loudness (EBU R128 / ATSC A/85) compliance metering.
pm_recommendations.proposed_solution: Implement AudioStemMixerSpec, omni_director.tools.audio_mixer (DAW track manifests and loudness estimation), and a slide-out 4-channel audio mixing desk with Web Audio acoustic synthesis and canvas LED VU meters in the animatic.

pm_recommendations.title: Cinematic Optical Lens & Sensor Framing Suite (Anamorphic Squeeze, Focal Length, Hyperfocal Depth & Viewfinder Guides)
pm_recommendations.problem_statement: Directors of Photography and camera operators reviewing storyboards for 'SEPHORA: London Pulse (Continuous 40s Oner)' require precise optical modeling (sensor format crop factors, 1.33x/1.5x/2.0x anamorphic squeeze, horizontal field of view, hyperfocal distance) to avoid focal distortion in prompt generation, export lens metadata for ACs, and preview safe reticles directly in the animatic.
pm_recommendations.proposed_solution: Ship SensorFormat, AnamorphicSqueeze, OpticalLensSpec schemas, omni_director.tools.optical_lens (FOV and hyperfocal distance formulas, CSV metadata export, CRAFT optical prompt tokens), prompt auditor lens token verification, and Viewfinder Safe Guides HUD (#btn-viewfinder-animatic / #animatic-viewfinder-overlay [V] hotkey) in the HTML5 animatic.

pm_recommendations.title: Virtual Production LED Volume & Unreal Engine Stage Manifest / ICVFX Suite
pm_recommendations.problem_statement: High-end commercial productions for 'SEPHORA: London Pulse (Continuous 40s Oner)' increasingly film on curved LED volume stages with Unreal Engine 5 in-camera visual effects (ICVFX); production crews require nDisplay frustum tracking manifests, DMX lighting patch tables, and visual stage geometry blueprints directly from the storyboard bible.
pm_recommendations.proposed_solution: Ship LedWallGeometry, DmxLightingFixture, VirtualProductionStageSpec schemas, omni_director.tools.virtual_production (Unreal Engine nDisplay manifest JSON export, DMX lighting console patch CSV, frustum prompt tokens), and an interactive Virtual Production Stage Modal (#btn-vp-stage-animatic / #animatic-vp-stage-modal [P] hotkey) in the HTML5 animatic.

pm_recommendations.title: Kinetic Motion Control (MoCo) Rig & 6-DOF Camera Kinematics Engine
pm_recommendations.problem_statement: Complex kinetic camera maneuvers for 'SEPHORA: London Pulse (Continuous 40s Oner)' require precision mechanical motion control (Bolt Cinebot, Technocrane, Cablecam, Steadicam, FPV Drone) and 6-DOF trajectory waypoint tracking (X/Y/Z position, Roll/Pitch/Yaw orientation, velocity, acceleration) to guarantee repeatable camera paths and exportable camera tracking data for VFX pipelines (Nuke, Maya, Blender, Unreal Engine).
pm_recommendations.proposed_solution: Ship MotionControlRigType, TrajectoryWaypoint6DOF, MocoRigSpec schemas, omni_director.tools.moco_kinematics (path distance and velocity calculation, JSON, CSV, FBX ASCII camera transform exports), CRAFT camera MoCo prompt tokens, prompt auditor MoCo token verification, and an interactive MoCo Trajectory HUD (#btn-moco-animatic / #animatic-moco-hud [K] hotkey) in the animatic.

pm_recommendations.title: Volumetric Atmospheric & Studio Lighting Rig Simulator
pm_recommendations.problem_statement: High-end cinematic visuals for 'SEPHORA: London Pulse (Continuous 40s Oner)' require calibrated multi-point studio lighting (Key, Fill, Rim, Kicker, Practicals, Ambient) with color temperature (Kelvin), photometric illuminance (Lux), diffusion grades, particulate atmospheric haze/fog modeling, and lighting contrast ratios (Key:Fill, Key:Rim) to eliminate flat lighting and export gaffer setup call sheets.
